Four steps from soil to shelf.

One team follows every lot from the field to your receiving dock, so nothing is lost between hands.

Step 1

Picked at the right moment

We harvest from vetted farms across the Delta at export maturity, early in the day while the crop is cool.

Step 2

Graded and packed

Sorted by size and quality, then packed to the specification your market asks for.

Step 3

Cold from gate to port

Reefer containers with temperature logs on every lot, loaded the same day.

Step 4

Delivered and cleared

Customs, paperwork and last-mile delivery handled, with tracking until the pallet is signed for.

Where we ship: worldwide

Every continent.
